<!-- roadmap-reconciliation-2026-09-26 -->
## Current scope — September 26, 2026

[Current roadmap](https://github.com/kj-squared-labs/reflow-studio/blob/main/docs/roadmap-2026-09-26.md) · [Official versions/conflicts](https://github.com/kj-squared-labs/reflow-studio/blob/main/docs/evidence/2026-09-26-issue4/competition-contract.md). This amendment supersedes conflicting qualification assumptions in the older sections below; existing implementation evidence and uncompleted checks remain. No closure is claimed.

**Ready, P1.** Frozen family assignments, target/config fingerprints, exposure/migration tracking and bounded append preservation are landed. Remaining acceptance is actual new-family/near-duplicate/exposure admission. The sourcing task recorded two private sealed selections; do not search again or open them in development. Custodian must establish independent families, permissions and frozen private evaluation records before admission. Current manifest remains zero test families; no gate is lowered and no closure claimed.

---

## Earlier scope and evidence

## Evidence and priority
P1 unless marked otherwise. Reviewed at main `4adaba4`.

`scripts/lica-batch.ts:99-103` recalculates split assignments from the complete sorted family list. Reproducing its seed20260922 algorithm with a..j then adding family 0 reassigns six existing families between development and validation. Repeatability with an unchanged pool does not prevent this drift.

## Scope and dependencies
Finite #7 follow-up before corpus expansion or label collection; coordinate #20/#21. Preserve existing disclosed development/validation contamination history; do not manufacture a clean holdout from seen families.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Persist versioned family assignments; adding/reordering/removing sources cannot move a known family across splits.
- [ ] Explicit migration records old/new assignments and exposure; touched holdout families are retired, not silently relabeled as untouched.
- [ ] Tests cover new families, repeated templates/near-duplicate review markers, restart and reordered manifests; genuinely new approved families can be added deterministically.
- [ ] Freeze target ratios/config/hash alongside split manifest and reserve fresh external test families before tuning.

## Delivery and closure
Read the [dated roadmap/adversarial review](https://github.com/kj-squared-labs/reflow-studio/blob/main/docs/roadmap-2026-09-22.md) and repository instructions. Plan under docs/plans, demonstrate meaningful failing behavior before production changes, preserve valid positive controls, run npm test/build and required native/browser checks. Link commit, plan, red/green and final evidence before closing this issue. Direct validated main commits; optional jo/ branches; no required PR/reviewer. Coordinate shared files. This is planned backlog work, not an instruction to start another In Progress task.

<!-- october-13-priority -->
## October 13 pickup order

Backlog during the current bounded run. First finish independent typography evidence #95, source fidelity #102 and development accounting #98; release coordination #101 selects a justified follow-up only after that evidence. This preserves the existing acceptance scope; no worker is assigned implicitly.
